[Quick Review] ViHateT5: Enhancing Hate Speech Detection in Vietnamese With A Unified Text-to-Text Transformer Model
May 23, 2024 - Regarding this ACL 2024 paper, this review summarizes ViHateT5, a unified text-to-text transformer model for Vietnamese hate speech detection. Existing hate speech detection (HSD) systems for Vietnamese require specialized fine-tuned models, leading to complexity and fragmentation in multitasking setups.
